alerte.texte: The fast-switch, cold-start and break-the-app tours found real bugs on main: the bottom bar under very fast taps, the Profile right after a cold start, and quick repeated votes. Each has its ticket and someone fixing it. Messages, drafts and the Trending tests are merged; a chain reaction that archived the measuring machines is understood and fixed.

depuis.texte: Drafts: deleting a draft also deletes its private media from the phone.
Auto-curator: relay container error lines to Workers logs
Curator: refuse unplayable YouTube videos and photo-only X posts
Trending never shows a Take's results (already true in the app since the vote fix); this adds tests and profiling tools.
Website: retire the web BFF and call the gateway directly
Messages: the input grows over several lines and typing @ shows suggestions; the Messages tour is no slower than before.
Website tests: a test that failed about half the time under load is now deterministic.
Server: exact admission counter storage windows overlap
Bottom bar: the haptic tick is prepared during launch without slowing it, and lands on time from the very first tap.
Vote: after a refused vote, reopening the Take shows the real vote from the server, silently.
Map: after a search, the camera flies to the place in one continuous move, with 2 to 3 times fewer map tiles.
Row haptics: the tick lands exactly when the bar arrives, on tap and on swipe, on every tab row.
Server: a dormant guard for guest Take snapshots.
Profile: opens instantly, no header jump and no skeleton, and stops re-reading in the background when you are not looking at it.
Website: the web manifest is linked with credentials.
Native tabs: the right tab lights up in dark mode and with Increase Contrast, and the old word turns off at once.
Server: a video's completion is recorded after its source locks.
Server: a tip's payment authorization is recorded in one go.
App: the Home pager recovers swipes interrupted by a tap.
Vote: the chart and results move the moment you vote; a refused vote stays shown, like an Instagram like.
Explore pages no longer redraw for a read in flight, and a flaky test is fixed.
perf(api): reduce Category pin round trips while retaining fresh snapshots
perf(api): reduce OAuth PATCH round trips with guarded retries
Expo update, with Nearby redrawing less. Replaces the earlier Expo PR, which is now closed.
Server: an expert note's lock folds into its upsert.
Server: a tip's admission decision and insert happen in one go.
Your fast-tab bug: on the profile, the page follows the chosen tab again, even with chained taps and swipes.
Server: prototype of exact publication counting.
Server: a report reads its outcome and the reporter's lock in one go.
Notifications: rows no longer move under your finger, and the list is ready before you arrive.
Tools: the app's ESLint replaced by oxlint.
Tools: Prettier replaced by oxfmt.
Server: recursive SQL counts stay fresh through the cache.
Server: the route census opens the seeded announcement.
Explore keeps its read failures and retries them. Replaces the old PR #4507.
App: required route parameters are kept.
Wheel titles without “(HH:mm)”, in all six languages.
Privacy: real values, greyed out while loading.
A website script fixed: CI did not cover it.
Video preview: pause holds when you change the speed.
Main's CI is green again: Expo Doctor no longer blocks.
Intermediate sweep evidence recorded.
Announcement opening measured only with available test data.
The vote streak is removed everywhere, as you decided.

equipe: Here on the Mac: Claudes on the tabs, the bottom bar, the cold-start tests and the break-the-app tests.

On Replicas: eleven measurers (three on PRs, eight on tours) and the reviewers, through their Claude agents while Codex is out of quota, plus agents fixing the map, the images and the neighbouring pages.
etapes: Merge each PR as soon as its measurement comes back clean: Explore, the Explore bar, the counters, then the share counter.
Finish the map preparation, then the planet; the images, the neighbouring pages and the tabs.
Fix the bugs the tours found tonight, each with a test that was red on main.
Full test loop on the final main, on the Mac's simulator, plus a last fast-switch tour.
Redeploy the staging API on that same commit, then the list of what won't be in the build, shown to you.
Launch build 196, then hand you the emulator on main.
